name: co-architect
description: Architecture-firm collaboration variant (co-design consumer) — five-team workspace (design, research, project, engineering, platform-engineering) over six named workflows, producing design deliverables, CAD drawings (ZWCAD DWG), SketchUp models, and client-ready reports.

artifacts.description: Work-in-progress design documents, proposals, and CAD working files.
Design specifications, spatial patterns, and design-delivery handoff packages.
Final client-ready deliverables: feasibility reports, permit DWG packages, render/elevation presentations.

handoffs.trigger: Intake analysis approved; design direction dispatch
Design frozen at Phase 2 gate; 3D artifact build
Permit drawing specs and detail setup complete; DWG production

notes: Hub consumer (variant.json hub.role=consumer, consumes co-design >= 1.0.0) — consumes the design-doctrine hub assets owned by co-design. CAD deliverables run through the skills registered in variant.json (cad-server-manager, zwcad-ai-drawing, cad-space-recognition, cad-svg-preview, generate-room-elevation) over MCP servers resolved via the root package.json dependency tree. Engineering Team starts only after the Phase 2 gate (design-delivery workflow).
